item.title: Weather to Change Again: Rain, snow likely in Western Himalayas; Fog alert issued
item.description: Weather patterns across India are shifting again as a fresh western disturbance is expected to impact the western Himalayan region from February 8. Light rain and snowfall are likely in Jammu-Kashmir, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand, while dense fog may affect parts of North India and eastern Uttar Pradesh.

item.title: Patna: Pappu Yadav arrested in 1995 case, MP expresses fear over health and safety
item.description: The arrest of Purnia MP Pappu Yadav in connection with a 1995 criminal case has triggered political and legal reactions in Patna. Police detained him after he allegedly failed to appear in court. During custody, Yadav expressed concerns about his health and safety and requested to go directly to court.

item.title: India, US reach interim trade deal to cut tariffs and boost market access; Full details here
item.description: India and the United States have agreed on a framework for an interim trade agreement aimed at reducing tariffs, improving market access, and strengthening supply chains. India will lower duties on several U.S. industrial, food, and agricultural products, while the U.S. to impose 18% reciprocal tariffs.

item.title: Ola, Uber, Rapido drivers call nationwide strike; Commutes likely hit
item.description: Drivers linked to Ola, Uber, and Rapido have launched a nationwide strike dubbed the “All India Breakdown,” keeping ride-hailing apps shut and disrupting daily travel in many cities. Unions, including the Telangana Gig Workers Union, are protesting the lack of fixed minimum fares and alleged arbitrary commission cuts by companies.

item.title: FIR filed against IPS Officer over 2023 narcotics raid in Delhi; Details here
item.description: Delhi Police’s vigilance unit has registered an FIR against IPS officer Shankar Choudhary over alleged abuse of authority during a 2023 narcotics operation in south west Delhi. The probe cites unauthorised raids, illegal detention of a Nigerian national, and failure to document seized property.

item.title: Rain threat looms over Pakistan vs Netherlands T20 World Cup opener; Here’s what you need to know
item.description: Rain threatens the Pakistan vs Netherlands opener in the T20 World Cup 2026 at Colombo, with delays or a washout possible. The match is scheduled for 11 AM IST, but forecasts indicate showers through the day and heavier rain during the second innings.

item.title: Speeding truck rams into stranded passengers in UP; 6 Killed, probe underway
item.description: A devastating road accident occurred on the Yamuna Expressway in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, when a speeding container truck rammed into passengers who had stepped off a bus early Saturday morning. Six people were killed and several others injured.

item.title: Opposition up in arms over India-US interim trade deal; Key leaders speak out
item.description: The India-US interim trade agreement joint statement released today and it has triggered political controversy. Opposition leaders, including Congress MPs Manish Tewari and Jairam Ramesh, and SP and TMC representatives, criticized the deal for potentially harming Indian farmers, increasing trade deficits, and weakening economic sovereignty.

item.title: BJP’s Ritu Tawde elected Mumbai Mayor; Shiv Sena gets Deputy Mayor post
item.description: Senior BJP corporator Ritu Tawde has been elected as Mumbai’s new BMC Mayor, marking the first time a BJP candidate holds this post in 40 years. Shiv Sena (Shinde faction) leader Sanjay Ghadi will serve as Deputy Mayor.
